lessonTurns.text: Oh, hello, welcome to my evening routine.

lessonTurns.text: I've just finished work for the day,

lessonTurns.text: so I am going to show you how I spend my evening.

lessonTurns.text: And we're going to learn lots of very useful English.

lessonTurns.text: So I've just had a full day of teaching, I teach online.
lessonTurns.zh: 我今天教了一整天的课，我在线上教课。
